testPlan.title: Undo a name a vehicle is heading to

test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: This ticks by itself. Nothing to do.

test.title: Send a vehicle to a name you just made
test.hint: 1. In the editor, make a new name for a spot on a road. 2. Use AutoDrive to send a vehicle to that name. 3. Click PASS once the vehicle is on its way there.

test.title: Undo the name
test.passLog: current destination was a marker the undo removed
test.hint: Press undo once. This name is taken back. The test ticks by itself when the game records it. Nothing to click.

test.title: The vehicle stops where the name was
test.hint: Keep watching the vehicle. It should drive on to the spot where the name was, then stop there. It should NOT turn round or drive off to Main Farm. AutoDrive may switch off when it stops; that is expected. A message may say it reached Main Farm; ignore that message. Click PASS if the vehicle stopped at the spot. Click FAIL if it did anything else.
